meta.description: A website built around your Lockii booking widget, for self-service rentals.

hero.heading: A website that books your Lockii rentals
hero.lead: Lockii runs your rentals without staff. We build the website that gets them found and booked, with your Lockii booking built in from day one. For rental businesses anywhere in the US.

why.heading: Nobody answers the phone at an unstaffed rental.
why.lead: So the website does the job your staff would:
jobs: Explain how pickup works, whether a hitch is needed, and what the deposit covers.
Show up when someone searches for a trailer or a kayak on their phone, the moment they need one.
Reach your Lockii booking in two taps. Lockii takes the booking, the ID check and the payment.
why.close: A clear, fast site around it is what gets someone to start.

tiers.presence: Your fleet is already booked through repeat customers and word of mouth. Give them a pickup page that answers the questions, and a booking that works.
tiers.growth: You want people typing "trailer rental" and your town to find you. We study those searches and build the site to show up for them.
tiers.agile: A new kind of rental, or a fleet that keeps changing. We research where the data doesn't exist yet and keep adjusting the site as you go.

closing.heading: Let's get your rentals booked.
closing.sub: Tell us what you rent and where. We usually reply within one business day.
